intro: Palestinian culture is rich in embroidery, poetry, music and food, and is a strong part of Palestinian identity.

chapters.title: Arts
text: Tatreez embroidery, with patterns that once showed which village a woman came from, is on UNESCO's heritage list. Mahmoud Darwish is the national poet. The dabke is a line dance performed at weddings.

chapters.title: Food
text: Musakhan (roast chicken with onions and sumac on flatbread), maqluba ('upside down' rice), knafeh from Nablus, za'atar and olive oil are classic foods.
